data.title: 木更 · 学校日常
data.description: 【木更 · 学校日常】明亮的高中走廊里，换上标准百褶裙校服的木更在下课的人流中俏皮转身，双手背在身后向你投来温柔甜美的微笑——「在学校里我可是完美的高中生后辈哦。修，今天放学后的打工，我也要和你在一起！」
data.camera: medium shot, walking through the sunny school corridor with a playful smile
data.promptProse: Kisara turns in the sunny school corridor with a playful smile, long pastel hair moving beside her sailor collar and red bow. Grey puff-sleeved jacket, white pleated skirt and black knee socks retain the uniform; the small right-thigh bandage remains ordinary costume detail. The medium view follows corridor windows and classroom doors behind. Clear afternoon light illuminates her face and jacket folds, casting repeating frame shadows along the hallway floor.
